expectedRoute.rationale: The cutoff evidence describes internet payments infrastructure with payment volume, financial-infrastructure products and financing activity.

binaryClaims.statement: Stripe's Series I financing was public before the 2024-03-15 cutoff.
Stripe reported being cash-flow positive in 2023.
Stripe said the Series I capital was needed to run the business.

observableClaims.statement: Stripe's Series I was announced at a USD 50 billion headline valuation.
Stripe announced a Series I fundraise of more than USD 6.5 billion.
Stripe users processed USD 1 trillion through Stripe in 2023.

expectedAbstentions.description: The Series I release and annual letter do not disclose private share rights or a cap table.
The Series I headline valuation may not be converted into enterprise value without debt, cash, share-count and rights evidence.

mustNotConflate: Series I headline valuation with enterprise value
employee liquidity funding with operating capital need
headline valuation with security-level fair value
valuationSeparationExpectations.notes: Manifest marks the case ineligible for historical valuation-error scoring despite a public headline financing valuation.

completenessExpectations.description: A complete answer should cover payments route, payment volume, Series I financing purpose, cash-flow status and security-rights abstentions.

historicalValuationTargets.reason: Manifest marks this case ineligible because secondary valuations and tender references lack public share-rights and cap-table evidence.
